optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: User Research Operations Specialist, Credit Workflow System

professionalSummary.text: Programme owner for credit workflow system research operations with two years of end-to-end ownership, including compliance sign-off delegation and participant recruitment from bank staff.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the research operations programme for the credit workflow product for two years as the named programme owner, holding the compliance sign-off on each research plan under the delegation recorded with the compliance office.

professionalSummary.text: Led quarterly research planning sessions with product design team, documenting decisions in planning notes and coordinating logistics with compliance and business units.
professionalSummary.witness: Led the quarterly research planning session with the product design team, deciding the research calendar and recording the decisions in the planning notes.

experienceHighlights.text: Held compliance sign-off on research plans through delegation recorded with compliance office, maintaining full accountability for research quality and consent records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the research operations programme for the credit workflow product for two years as the named programme owner, holding the compliance sign-off on each research plan under the delegation recorded with the compliance office.

experienceHighlights.text: Recruited underwriters and relationship managers as participants through business units, maintaining participant and consent records in research repository.
experienceHighlights.witness: Recruited underwriters and relationship managers as participants through the business units and maintained the participant and consent records in the research repository.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented research planning decisions in quarterly planning notes, including research calendar and participant availability coordination.
experienceHighlights.witness: Led the quarterly research planning session with the product design team, deciding the research calendar and recording the decisions in the planning notes.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes compliance delegation record, signed research plan, and quarterly planning notes with research repository identifiers for verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the compliance delegation record naming the candidate for research-plan sign-off, one signed research plan and the planning notes for one quarter, with the research repository's record identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Research operations programme ownership, compliance sign-off delegation, participant recruitment, consent record maintenance, and quarterly planning session leadership.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included programme ownership, plan sign-off, participant recruitment, consent records and the quarterly planning session over about two years.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish end-to-end ownership of research operations, compliance sign-off delegation, participant recruitment, consent records, quarterly planning sessions, and coordination with compliance/business units. The materials do not establish documentation of research limitations or hand-over conditions (req_5f14a224a60b).
